title: Measuring Political Stance and Consistency in Large Language Models
findings: On the question of whether religion should play a role in social life and politics, Grok-3-mini and Mistral endorsed this role, while the other models did not. Five of the nine models changed their stance on this issue when the question was paraphrased, indicating weakly held positions.
